The `owned_by` predicate requires a subject (the owner) and an object (the owned item), while the `has` predicate requires a holder (the entity possessing the item). The action contexts further illustrate this difference: `owned_by` is used in contexts related to transactions and transfers of ownership, whereas `has` is used in contexts related to holding or possessing items. The `JACK_NP` source provides examples of actions that utilize each predicate differently, reinforcing the complementary relationship. Specifically, `owned_by` is used in the `sell_cow_for_beans` action to describe the ownership transfer of a cow, while `has` is used in the `steal_gold_bags` and `steal_harp` actions to describe the possession of items by a giant.
